lead.t: Avoid non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) if dengue, viral haemorrhagic fevers, peptic ulcer disease, or renal impairment are suspected.

snip.t: Avoid non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) if dengue, viral haemorrhagic fevers, peptic ulcer disease, or renal impairment are suspected.
